title: Consistent Geometric Deep Learning via Hilbert Bundles and Cellular Sheaves
abstract: arXiv:2605.06395v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern deep learning architectures increasingly contend with sophisticated signals that are natively infinite-dimensional, such as time series, probability distributions, or operators, and are defined over irregular domains. Yet, a unified learning theory for these settings has been lacking. To start addressing this gap, we introduce a novel convolutional learning framework for possibly infinite-dimensional signals supported on a manifold. Namely, we use the connection Laplacian associated with a Hilbert bundle as a convolutional operator, and we derive filters and neural networks, dubbed as \textit{HilbNets}. We make HilbNets and, more generally, the convolution operation, implementable via a two-stage sampling procedure. translated_title: 基于希尔伯特丛与胞腔层的一致几何深度学习
translated_abstract: 现代深度学习架构越来越多地需要处理本质上为无穷维的复杂信号，例如时间序列、概率分布或算子，这些信号定义在不规则的域上。然而，针对这些情形一直缺乏统一的学习理论。为开始填补这一空白，我们针对定义在流形上的、可能为无穷维的信号，提出了一种新颖的卷积学习框架。具体而言，我们将与希尔伯特丛相关联的联络拉普拉斯算子用作卷积算子，并由此推导出滤波器和神经网络，称为 HilbNets。我们通过一个两阶段的采样过程使 HilbNets 以及更一般的卷积运算得以实现。首先，我们证明对流形进行采样会诱导出一个希尔伯特胞腔层——这是一种具有希尔伯特特征空间和逐边耦合规则的广义图结构，并且我们证明了其层拉普拉斯算子收敛……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了 HilbNets——一种以希尔伯特丛的联络拉普拉斯算子作为卷积算子的新型卷积学习框架，可处理流形上可能无穷维的信号，并通过采样诱导的希尔伯特胞腔层使卷积运算得以实际实现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HilbNets, a novel convolutional learning framework that uses the connection Laplacian of a Hilbert bundle as the convolution operator for possibly infinite-dimensional signals on manifolds, made implementable through sampling-induced Hilbert cellular sheaves.
